title: Robert W. Beck Appointed to Encore Capital Group Board of Directors
summary: SAN DIEGO, Aug. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Encore Capital Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: ECPG), an international specialty finance company, announced today the appointment of Robert (Rob) Beck to its board of directors, effective immediately. He will serve on the Board’s Audit and Risk Committees. Mr. Beck is a seasoned financial services executive with more than 30 years of experience leading complex financial services businesses.
